meta.about: R12 agent eval: does each AI app get the right lines about the owner and none it must not? Made-up owner (Rust and Python developer in Pune); nothing here is a real person's. Each case's vault is `base` plus its own `vault` block, built in a temp folder through cortex.vault. Layer A checks the text the case's `client` is served on its `serve` channels (prime: cortex_prime over MCP as that client; rules: the rules-file block app/targets.py writes for it; pack:<name>: that context pack) for `must_serve` and `forbid` substrings (any case). Layer B sends that text plus `prompt` to a loaded local model three times; each reply must match every `regex_all`, no `regex_none` and hold no `must_not_leak` substring (any case). A case with `known_failure` (why) is reported as a known failure while Layer A fails. Adapted from Gemini round 5's A01-A10 (G-Q8-1..11); `adapted` says where and why.
meta.vault_block: pages: [{kind, id, fields, body, folder?}] (Vault.create_note); lines: [[me page, section, '- line']] (Vault.append_to_section); guesses: [[me page, section, text]] (cortex_patch with no user_confirmed: an agent's guess, served (ask)); mute: [claim line text] (the X-ray's mute, xray.set_flag)
